selection: Minimum mean validation joint-mirror-equivalent seven-parameter MSE over three seeds; all variants use this same metric. Freeze ranking before opening test predictions.
test_policy: Evaluate only baseline and selected variant, report original periodic and joint-mirror metrics together. Existing test set is previously inspected, not a new blind test.
quality_scope: Existing 1.0 Au-bottom dataset with known Au loss-fit limitations; optimize numerical inverse learning only.
refinement_note: Before any new test evaluation, add raw+mirror and shape+mirror controls to distinguish symmetry-loss benefits from spectral-view benefits. Reuse the first five variants' unchanged training runs. No test-guided tuning.
